newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Australian net exports detract from Q2 GDP.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian net exports detract from Q2 GDP.

text.p: Australia's net exports in the March quarter made a negative contribution of 0.9 point to expenditure-based gross domestic product (GDP), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said, confirming previously released data.

The Bureau said the seasonally adjusted balance of trade in goods and services for the quarter showed a surplus of A$60 million in 1989/90 prices, from an upward revised A$1.018 billion surplus previously.
In volume terms, exports of goods and services fell 1.1 percent to A$25.176 billion, while imports rose 2.8 percent to A$25.116 billion.

The bureau said the unadjusted June quarter capital account surplus of A$6.103 billion in current prices was made up of A$3.631 billion net debt financing, while net equity financing and net other financing made contributions of A$2.44 billion and A$34 million respectively.
